Hi Laura and Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lumensoft has a mix of EU-hosted SaaS customers and a growing APAC pipeline that requires a local-stay option for model inference. Rather than a full Private deployment, we want to explore a small-footprint "privacy gateway" that sits in customer VPCs and routes requests to Redwood Dedicated while enforcing residency and logging controls.

Attached is a short architecture request we sketched (privacy-gateway-arch.pdf) and our signed NDA (lumensoft-ndasigned.pdf). Key asks:
- Data egress controls per country (Poland, DE, SG)
- KMS integration patterns and what we can expose for key wrapping
- Audit log schema and retention options
- Latency SLO impact estimates for the gateway hop

Can the Redwood team run a feasibility check and propose a minimal pilot (4–6 weeks) we can run with two customers in EU and one in SG? We'll want a joint runbook and a short compatibility matrix for SI partners.

Best,
Marta
Head of Integrations — Lumensoft

Hi Marta — thanks for sending this along and for the NDA.

High level: this is doable and aligns with the "edge connector" pattern we've sketched internally, but there are a few important constraints to call out upfront:
1) Residency control is policy-driven at the routing layer; the gateway would tag requests and Redwood routing would honor region pins — this adds ~10–25ms depending on region and model.
2) KMS integrations: we can support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) via a wrapping key pattern; partner SIs will need permissions to set up the key policy.
3) Audit logs: we can stream structured logs to a customer or partner endpoint; retention policy needs to be agreed (default 90 days, enterprise tier can extend).

Next steps I propose:
- Technical deep-dive with Sergio to confirm networking and cert rotation model (30–45m).
- SI compatibility checklist for EdgeWorks (we'll loop them in).
- Draft pilot action items (I started a sheet: pilot-action-items.xlsx)

Vanessa — can you weigh in on whether our standard Private addendum covers the log retention and KMS policy requirements, or if we need a tailored addendum for this pilot?

Marta — when would you like to start? We have a two-week window starting 2027-06-21 for kickoff.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Laura / Marta — quick technical notes after reviewing the diagram:

1) Gateway deployment model options (pros/cons):
   - Lightweight reverse-proxy (container): easiest to deploy, relies on outbound TLS only, limited control over KMS policies.
   - VM appliance with HSM passthrough: more complex but allows customer-managed HSM and stricter key control.
   - VPC Endpoint + private-link style: best for network isolation, requires cloud partner setup per region.

2) Routing and fallback: if a gateway tags as "EU-pin" but Dedicated capacity in the EU is saturated, we can fall back to a compatible quantized variant in a nearby region — we'll include a fail-open / fail-closed option for compliance-sensitive customers.

3) Logs and PII redaction: we will implement a configurable scrubber in the gateway; default scrub rules remove common PII patterns unless the customer opts in for full request logs.

4) Pilot resource ask: one Redwood infra engineer for the initial 2-week setup + one SI engineer from EdgeWorks for customer-side networking.

I'll prepare a short tech appendix and a rough latency table by EOD Fri.

— Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
